content:
Here’s a polished version of your text:

> The trade replay issue, where RH reports **“REPL”** instead of **“NEWM”** to TRAX for our active trades that are not archived in CMRS, is caused by RH archiving story 2323911 and is affecting the #13 fix changes. The new ESP extract for #13 sends replay messages for rebooked trades, updated with the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. Since all of these are replay messages (`<SST_REPLAY> = 'Y'`), RH will report them as **“REPL”** to TRAX. As a result, TRAX will reject all #13 replay messages because they have never been reported to TRAX before. In short, the #13 replayed trade messages will be rejected just like other BAU replay messages, which means the #13 changes in both ESP and RH will have no effect.

If you want, I can also make it sound more formal, more concise, or more technical.
